title: Political career incentives and the environmental costs: Evidence from China’s promotion tournaments
title_primary: Political career incentives and the environmental costs: Evidence from China’s promotion tournaments
authors: JingXuan Xu, Hao Xu, Guangrong Ma
official: 官方在线 2026-09-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper shows that promotion incentives for county-level cadres in China are an important driver of air pollution deterioration. Building on the multi-winner tournament model proposed by Clark and Riis (1998), we predict an inverted-U-shaped relationship between the number of counties within a prefecture and the promotion incentives for county-level cadres. Using the length of small rivers as an instrumental variable for the number of counties within a prefecture, our empirical analysis identifies a robust inverted-U-shaped relationship between the number of counties and air pollution levels, suggesting that promotion incentives significantly exacerbate air pollution. Further analysis reveals that, in pursuit of economic growth, local cadres tend to relax environmental regulations and attract more pollution-intensive firms. In regions where cadres’ performance evaluation places less emphasis on economic growth, the inverted-U-shaped relationship does not exist. These findings suggest that local cadres’ career incentives stimulate economic growth at the expense of the environment.

title: From Pledges to Portfolios: Integrating Countries’ Climate Commitments into Sovereign Bond Investments
title_zh: 从承诺到投资组合：将国家气候承诺纳入主权债券投资
title_primary: 从承诺到投资组合：将国家气候承诺纳入主权债券投资
title_secondary: From Pledges to Portfolios: Integrating Countries’ Climate Commitments into Sovereign Bond Investments
authors: Fabio Alessandrini, Eric Jondeau, Lou-Salomé Vallée, Michelle Hanlon, Saumitra Jha 等
official: 官方在线 2025-03-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores the integration of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) into the construction of net-zero (NZ) portfolios of sovereign bonds. Based on both backward-looking (2015–2021) and forward-looking (2021–2030) analyses, we compare the effectiveness of scenarios using constant greenhouse gas (GHG) intensities and NDC-based trajectories in reducing the portfolio’s GHG intensity while minimizing the tracking error relative to the business-as-usual benchmark. The backward-looking exercise reveals that NDC-based portfolios achieve similar GHG intensity reductions with lower tracking errors compared to constant-intensity scenarios, demonstrating their efficacy in building an NZ portfolio. Conversely, constant-intensity strategies require more aggressive rebalancing, leading to higher tracking errors and uneven allocations. In the forward-looking exercise, the more ambitious second round of NDCs announced before COP26 enables substantial GHG intensity reductions at a marginal financial cost. Overall, our results highlight the potential of NDCs as a forward-looking tool to align sovereign bond portfolios with climate objectives while maintaining financial performance. However, imposing weight restrictions by country or region, to ensure more equitable investment between advanced and emerging economies, significantly limits the ability to meet reduction targets and increases tracking errors.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将国家自主贡献（NDCs）纳入主权债券净零（NZ）投资组合构建的实践。基于回溯性（2015-2021年）与前瞻性（2021-2030年）两种分析，我们比较了采用恒定温室气体（GHG）强度与基于NDC的减排路径两种情景在降低投资组合GHG强度、同时最小化相对于常规基准的跟踪误差方面的有效性。回溯性分析显示，与恒定强度情景相比，基于NDC的投资组合在实现相似的GHG强度降低的同时，具有更低的跟踪误差，从而证明了其在构建净零投资组合中的有效性。相反，恒定强度策略要求更为激进的再平衡操作，导致较高的跟踪误差及不均衡的配置。在前瞻性分析中，COP26之前宣布的更具雄心的第二轮NDC使得在边际财务成本较低的情况下实现显著的GHG强度削减。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了NDC作为前瞻性工具，在保持财务绩效的同时，使主权债券投资组合与气候目标相一致的潜力。然而，为确保发达经济体与新兴经济体之间更为均衡的投资，按国家或地区施加权重限制，则会显著限制实现减排目标的能力，并增加跟踪误差。

title: Democracy, Redistribution, and Inequality: Evidence from the English Poor Law
title_zh: 民主、再分配与不平等：来自英国济贫法的证据
title_primary: 民主、再分配与不平等：来自英国济贫法的证据
title_secondary: Democracy, Redistribution, and Inequality: Evidence from the English Poor Law
authors: Jonathan Chapman
official: 官方在线 2026-02-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper tests whether inequality shapes the redistributive impact of democratization by examining changes to the governance of councils providing poor relief — rudimentary social insurance — in nineteenth-century Britain. An 1894 reform removed institutional features — a graduated franchise, property qualifications, the absence of a secret ballot, and the participation of unelected magistrates — that allowed landowners to control spending on poor relief after the 1832 Great Reform Act. The empirical analysis uses a new annual dataset of poor law spending from 1884-1905 to test whether higher pre-reform inequality amplified the effect of democratic reform on redistribution. The results support the Meltzer-Richard hypothesis: higher local income inequality led to higher poor relief spending after 1894. Areas where landed elites held political power saw smaller increases in expenditure, indicating that de facto elite influence muted the effect of democratization. These findings provide empirical support for models of democratization that focus on demands for redistribution.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察19世纪英国济贫理事会治理结构的变化，检验不平等是否塑造了民主化的再分配效应。1894年的一项改革取消了允许地主在1832年《大改革法案》后控制济贫支出的制度特征——包括分级选举权、财产资格限制、无记名投票的缺失以及非选举治安法官的参与。实证分析利用1884年至1905年间新的济贫法支出年度数据集，检验改革前更高的不平等是否放大了民主改革对再分配的影响。结果支持梅尔策-理查德假说：1894年后，地方收入不平等程度越高，济贫支出增加越多。土地精英掌握政治权力的地区支出增幅较小，表明事实上的精英影响力削弱了民主化的效应。这些发现为强调再分配需求的民主化模型提供了实证支持。

title: Investment-Based Trade-Off Theory
title_zh: 基于投资的权衡理论
title_primary: 基于投资的权衡理论
title_secondary: Investment-Based Trade-Off Theory
authors: Dirk Hackbarth, Axel Stahmer
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a novel trade-off theory of capital structure. When frequent re-balancing of firm leverage is restricted due to capital structure stickiness (or refinancing frictions), optimal capital structure reflects current and future investment profitability. That is, optimal leverage crucially depends on the asset growth and tax rate, and yields various capital structure equilibria, such as all-debt, all-equity, and debt-equity financing, by balancing the tax benefits of debt and the cash benefits of equity. Notably, the model endogenously generates low and zero leverage and also offers insights into the determinants of leverage life-cycle patterns observed in practice
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种新颖的资本结构权衡理论。当频繁调整企业杠杆受到资本结构粘性（或再融资摩擦）限制时，最优资本结构反映了当前及未来的投资盈利能力。即，最优杠杆率关键取决于资产增长率和税率，并通过平衡债务的税收利益与股权的现金利益，产生多种资本结构均衡，如全债务、全股权及债务-股权混合融资。值得注意的是，该模型内生地产生了低杠杆和零杠杆现象，并为实践中观察到的杠杆生命周期模式的决定因素提供了洞见。

title: Connectivity and Selective Rural Migration
title_zh: 连通性与选择性农村迁移
title_primary: 连通性与选择性农村迁移
title_secondary: Connectivity and Selective Rural Migration
authors: Lin Ma, Yuan Mei, Qunfeng Wu, Mingzhi (Jimmy) Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How does infrastructure shape rural development? Using household panel data from a nationally representative sample of Chinese villages, matched to high‐resolution highway maps, we find that road expansion between 2000 and 2015 operates mainly through reallocation, with less productive farmers scaling down or exiting and more productive farmers remaining and expanding. We quantify the aggregate and distributional consequences in a dynamic spatial equilibrium model with heterogeneous households and endogenous migration. Improved connectivity not only accelerates urbanization but also increases aggregate rural output by 2.2%–5.3% in the long run, even as the rural workforce declines.
abstract_zh: 基础设施如何塑造农村发展？利用来自中国村庄全国代表性样本的家庭面板数据，并结合高分辨率公路地图，我们发现2000年至2015年间道路扩张主要通过重新配置发挥作用，生产效率较低的农户缩减规模或退出，而生产效率较高的农户则留存并扩张。我们在一个包含异质性家庭和内生迁移的动态空间均衡模型中量化了总体及分配效应。改善连通性不仅加速了城市化进程，而且长期内使农村总产出增加2.2%至5.3%，即便农村劳动力减少也是如此。

title: Worker Rights in Collective Bargaining
title_zh: 集体谈判中的工人权利
title_primary: 集体谈判中的工人权利
title_secondary: Worker Rights in Collective Bargaining
authors: Benjamin W. Arold, Elliott Ash, Bentley MacLeod, Suresh Naidu, Christian Dustmann 等
official: 官方在线 2025-03-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops novel natural language methods to analyze the empirical determinants and economic value of these rights using a new collection of 30,000 CBAs from Canada in the period 1986-2015. We parse legally binding rights (e.g., “workers shall receive…”) and obligations (e.g., “the employer shall provide…”) from contract text, and validate our measures through evaluation of clause pairs and comparison to firm surveys on HR practices. Using time-varying province-level variation in labor income tax rates, we find that higher taxes increase the share of worker-rights clauses while reducing pre-tax wages in unionized firms, consistent with a substitution effect away from taxed wages toward untaxed rights. Further, an exogenous increase in the value of outside options (from a leave-one-out instrument for labor demand) increases the share of worker rights clauses in CBAs. Combining the regression estimates, we infer that a one-standard-deviation increase in worker rights is valued at about 5.7% of wages.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了新颖的自然语言处理方法，利用1986-2015年间加拿大收集的30,000份集体 bargaining 协议（CBAs）新数据集，分析这些权利的经验决定因素及其经济价值。我们从合同文本中解析具有法律约束力的权利（如“工人应获得……”）和义务（如“雇主应提供……”），并通过评估条款对及与企业人力资源实践调查的比较来验证我们的度量。利用省级劳动所得税率的时变差异，我们发现较高的税收增加了工人权利条款的比例，同时降低了工会化企业的税前工资，这与从征税工资向未征税权利的替代效应一致。此外，外部选择价值的外生增加（通过留一法工具变量衡量劳动需求）提高了CBA中工人权利条款的比例。结合回归估计，我们推断工人权利的一个标准差增加约相当于工资的5.7%的价值。

title: The strong core of housing markets with partial order preferences
title_zh: 具有偏序偏好的住房市场的强核
title_primary: 具有偏序偏好的住房市场的强核
title_secondary: The strong core of housing markets with partial order preferences
authors: Ildikó Schlotter, Mirabel Mendoza-Cadena
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the strong core of housing markets when agents’ preferences over houses are expressed as partial orders. We provide a structural characterization of the strong core, and propose an efficient algorithm that finds an allocation in the strong core or decides that it is empty, even in the presence of forced and forbidden arcs. The algorithm satisfies the property of weak group-strategyproofness. Additionally, we show that certain results known for the strong core in the case where agents’ preferences are weak orders can be extended to the setting with partial order preferences; among others, we show that the strong core in such housing markets satisfies the property of respecting improvements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人对房屋的偏好以偏序形式表达时住房市场的强核。我们提供了强核的结构性特征，并提出了一种高效算法，该算法能在存在强制弧和禁止弧的情况下找到强核中的分配或判定其为空。该算法满足弱群体策略证明性。此外，我们证明，在代理人偏好为弱序的情况下已知的关于强核的某些结果可以扩展到偏序偏好设置中；其中，我们证明此类住房市场中的强核满足尊重改进的性质。

title: Sowing discontent: Foreign land acquisitions and satisfaction with democracy in Africa
title_zh: 播种不满：外国土地收购与非洲民主满意度
title_primary: 播种不满：外国土地收购与非洲民主满意度
title_secondary: Sowing discontent: Foreign land acquisitions and satisfaction with democracy in Africa
authors: Kangwook Han
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) in agriculture—particularly through large-scale land acquisitions—has become increasingly common across Africa. While existing studies have focused on the economic and environmental implications of these investments, their political effects remain underexplored. This study investigates how foreign land acquisitions shape citizens’ satisfaction with democracy in African democracies. By integrating spatial data from the Land Matrix with geo-referenced Afrobarometer survey responses (2002–2018), this study employs a difference-in-differences design to identify the causal impact of proximity to operational land deals. The findings suggest that foreign land acquisitions reduce democratic satisfaction through instrumental and intrinsic pathways. However, when local communities are meaningfully consulted, these negative effects are significantly mitigated. The results underscore that substantive consultation with local communities is a prerequisite for aligning foreign investment with sustainable development and inclusive growth, thereby offering new insights into how land-based FDI shapes democratic legitimacy in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 农业领域的外国直接投资（FDI）——尤其是通过大规模土地收购——在非洲日益普遍。尽管现有研究聚焦于这些投资的经济与环境影响，但其政治效应仍未得到充分探讨。本研究探讨外国土地收购如何影响非洲民主国家公民对民主的满意度。通过将Land Matrix的空间数据与地理参照的Afrobarometer调查数据（2002-2018年）相结合，本研究采用双重差分设计来识别接近运营中土地交易的因果影响。研究结果表明，外国土地收购通过工具性和内在性路径降低了民主满意度。然而，当地方社区被有意义地征询意见时，这些负面影响显著减弱。研究结果强调，与地方社区进行实质性磋商是将外国投资与可持续发展和包容性增长相结合的前提，从而为土地型外国直接投资如何塑造发展中国家的民主合法性提供了新的见解。

title: When Hotelling meets Shaked and Sutton: A Unified Linear Model of Product Differentiation
title_zh: 当霍特林遇到谢克德与萨顿：产品差异化的统一线性模型
title_primary: 当霍特林遇到谢克德与萨顿：产品差异化的统一线性模型

authors: Armin Schmutzler, Daniel Ershov, Elizabeth Lyons, Andres Hervas-Drane, Sandro Shelegia 等
official: 官方在线 2025-04-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides a simple unified discrete-choice framework for analyzing differentiated duopolies. This framework nests models of horizontal and vertical differentiation, including standard textbook models (Hotelling and Shaked-Sutton). Contrary to these models, it also applies to economic environments where horizontal differentiation coincides with positive correlation of product valuations across consumers, and environments where vertical differentiation coincides with negative correlation. The paper provides an equilibrium characterization that is applicable independently of the type of differentiation and the sign of the valuation correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个简单统一的离散选择框架，用于分析差异化双寡头市场。该框架涵盖了横向与纵向差异化模型，包括标准教科书模型（霍特林模型与谢克德-萨顿模型）。与这些模型不同，该框架同样适用于横向差异化与消费者产品估值正相关并存的经济环境，以及纵向差异化与估值负相关并存的经济环境。本文给出了一个独立于差异化类型及估值相关符号的均衡特征刻画。

title: Pharmaceutical Regulation and Incentives for Innovation in an International Perspective
title_zh: 药品监管与创新激励的国际视角
title_primary: 药品监管与创新激励的国际视角
title_secondary: Pharmaceutical Regulation and Incentives for Innovation in an International Perspective
authors: Dubois, Pierre
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine pharmaceutical regulations and incentives for innovation from an international perspective, highlighting the public good nature of healthcare innovation and its cross-border diffusion. We summarize the empirical evidence on how push and pull incentives shape R\D investment, innovation, and global access. We emphasize the role of strategic interdependencies and spillovers, including free-riding in R\D financing, learning-by-doing effects, drug shortages, reference pricing, and parallel trade. We then provide new evidence on the international spillovers of pull incentives on innovation, showing that international cooperation and innovative institutions are necessary to better align national regulations with the global objective of sustaining pharmaceutical innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们从国际视角审视药品监管与创新激励，强调医疗创新及其跨国传播的公共产品属性。我们总结了关于推动与拉动激励如何影响研发投资、创新及全球可及性的实证证据。我们着重探讨战略相互依赖与溢出效应，包括研发融资中的搭便车行为、干中学效应、药品短缺、参考定价及平行贸易。随后，我们提供了关于拉动激励对创新国际溢出的新证据，表明国际合作与创新制度对于更好地协调国家监管与维持药品创新的全球目标至关重要。

title: Sustainable adaptation in agriculture: exploring consumer support for low-carbon climate resilient crops
title_zh: 农业可持续适应：消费者对低碳气候韧性作物的支持研究
title_primary: 农业可持续适应：消费者对低碳气候韧性作物的支持研究
title_secondary: Sustainable adaptation in agriculture: exploring consumer support for low-carbon climate resilient crops
authors: Peter Tait, John Saunders, Jane Mullaney, Matthew Roskruge, Paul Rutherford
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural production systems around the globe are experiencing significant climate-driven pressures. As climate change effects intensify, agricultural adaptation must align with climate sustainability policy and consumers who are attentive to production that reduce supply-chain emissions. This study provides case-study evidence from New Zealand, where warming climatic conditions are driving exploration of alternative horticultural land uses such as bananas, and where consumer demand may influence whether such diversification pathways are commercially viable. We examine how preferences for cleaner production attributes shape banana demand using a discrete choice experiment of banana consumers designed to assess the effects of organic and spray-free production, carbon-zero claims, and local origin on consumer choices. A Latent Class Analysis identified preference heterogeneity finding 38% of consumers state willingness to pay for low environmental impact attributes: organic (+76%), spray-free (+33%) and carbon-zero (+23%), indicating potential demand for environmentally produced bananas aligned with a changing climate. The findings suggest that a differentiated domestic banana product could support sustainable production and climate-adaptive diversification but should be interpreted as case study stated-preference demand-side evidence rather than as an assessment of industry feasibility. Further evidence on production costs, supply-chain logistics, and revealed demand is needed before drawing stronger conclusions about commercial potential.
abstract_zh: 全球农业生产系统正面临显著的气候变化压力。随着气候变化影响加剧，农业适应措施必须与气候可持续政策及关注供应链减排的消费者需求相协调。本研究以新西兰为案例，该国气候变暖正推动香蕉等替代性园艺土地利用方式的探索，而消费者需求可能影响此类多元化路径的商业可行性。我们通过香蕉消费者离散选择实验，考察清洁生产属性偏好如何塑造香蕉需求，旨在评估有机生产、无农药生产、碳中和声明及本地来源对消费者选择的影响。潜在类别分析揭示了偏好异质性，发现38%的消费者愿意为低环境影响的属性支付溢价：有机（+76%）、无农药（+33%）和碳中和（+23%），这表明对适应气候变化的环境友好型香蕉存在潜在需求。研究结果表明，差异化本土香蕉产品可支持可持续生产与气候适应性多元化，但应将其解读为案例研究中的陈述偏好需求侧证据，而非行业可行性评估。在得出关于商业潜力的更可靠结论前，仍需进一步获取生产成本、供应链物流及显示性需求方面的证据。

title: The effect of network degree on bargaining: Experimental evidence from the field
title_zh: 网络度对议价的影响：来自田野实验的证据
title_primary: 网络度对议价的影响：来自田野实验的证据
title_secondary: The effect of network degree on bargaining: Experimental evidence from the field
authors: Ben D’Exelle, Christine Gutekunst, Arno Riedl
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We conduct an artefactual field experiment in real-existing trade networks to analyze how individual network degree affects bargaining demands and outcomes. We combine data from a bilateral bargaining experiment with data of trade networks in 24 villages in Uganda. To identify the effect of individual degree in the village trade network we experimentally vary the disclosure of participants’ identities in a bargaining pair. We derive hypotheses on how degree should affect behavior and find partial support for them. Specifically, we observe that individual degree affects bargaining demands in the predicted direction when one of the bargainers is informed about the network positions but not when both sides are informed. Moreover, network degree affects the likelihood of agreements and earnings, irrespective of the knowledge of the network positions of bargaining partners.
abstract_zh: 我们在真实存在的贸易网络中开展了一项人工实地实验，以分析个体网络度如何影响议价要求与结果。我们将双边议价实验的数据与乌干达24个村庄的贸易网络数据相结合。为了识别村庄贸易网络中个体度的影响，我们通过实验操作议价对中参与者身份的披露情况。我们提出了关于度应如何影响行为的假设，并发现这些假设得到了部分支持。具体而言，我们观察到，当议价双方中只有一方知晓网络位置信息时，个体度对议价要求的影响方向符合预测；但当双方都知晓时，这一影响则不显著。此外，无论议价对手的网络位置是否被知晓，网络度都会影响达成协议的可能性及收益。

title:
Fragmentation and the Future of
                    GVCs
title_zh: 碎片化与全球价值链的未来
title_primary: 碎片化与全球价值链的未来
title_secondary:
Fragmentation and the Future of
                    GVCs
authors: Francesco Paolo Conteduca, Michele Mancini, Giacomo Romanini, Simona Giglioli, Alessandro Borin 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the current confrontational geopolitical climate, countries have intensified the use of selective trade restrictions to exert economic coercion. This paper introduces targeted trade restrictions between a US‐centric bloc and a China‐centric bloc into a general equilibrium trade model that features nonlinear adjustments and input–output connections. We study how micro‐level restrictions—based on data identifying high‐weaponization‐potential products—affect welfare and the macroeconomic structure of global value chains (GVCs). Our findings reveal that while global economic integration is marginally affected, its topology changes: chains become more regional and rely more on non‐aligned countries acting as connectors between opposing blocs, in ways that may be hard to detect in standard trade data.
abstract_zh: 在当前对抗性地缘政治气候下，各国强化了选择性贸易限制手段以实施经济胁迫。本文将美国主导集团与中国主导集团之间的针对性贸易限制引入具有非线性调整特征和投入产出关联的一般均衡贸易模型。基于识别高武器化潜力产品的微观数据，我们研究了微观层面的限制措施如何影响福利与全球价值链的宏观经济结构。研究结果表明，尽管全球经济一体化受到轻微影响，但其拓扑结构发生了改变：价值链呈现区域化趋势，并更依赖不结盟国家作为对立集团之间的连接枢纽——这种变化在标准贸易数据中可能难以察觉。

title: New importer dynamics and the effects of trade shocks
title_zh: 新进口商动态与贸易冲击的影响
title_primary: 新进口商动态与贸易冲击的影响
title_secondary: New importer dynamics and the effects of trade shocks
authors: Victor Gimenez-Perales
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.
abstract_zh: 新进口商的存活率和进口份额随时间推移而提高。然而，一个包含进口进入成本和随机进口成本的多投入企业模型无法复现这些动态特征。本文证明，扩展后的模型能够与数据相吻合。我对两个模型进行了校准，并利用它们识别贸易冲击的影响。模拟结果表明，在新进口商动态特征下，进口价格下降带来的生产率提升幅度较小，但这些提升在企业间的分布更为广泛。

title: The Incredible Flexibility of Moment Matching
title_zh: 矩匹配的惊人灵活性
title_primary: 矩匹配的惊人灵活性
title_secondary: The Incredible Flexibility of Moment Matching
authors: Isaiah Andrews, Bas Sanders
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We ask how far the choice of which moments to match can push estimates in misspecified structural models. The answer is: very far. Under regularity conditions, an adversarial researcher informed about the data distribution can choose moments that render any parameter value the unique solution to the population moment-matching problem. Moreover, in many cases they can do so with little increase in model-implied standard errors relative to maximum likelihood. We illustrate both results in a menu-cost model.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨在错误设定的结构模型中，选择匹配哪些矩条件能在多大程度上影响估计结果。答案是：影响极大。在正则条件下，一位了解数据分布信息的对抗性研究者可以选择矩条件，使得任何参数值都成为总体矩匹配问题的唯一解。此外，在许多情况下，他们这样做时，模型隐含的标准误相较于最大似然估计仅有微小增加。我们通过一个菜单成本模型对这两个结论进行了说明。

title: The association between parent–child discrepancies in educational expectations and adolescents’ cognitive ability
title_zh: 亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关联
title_primary: 亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关联
title_secondary: The association between parent–child discrepancies in educational expectations and adolescents’ cognitive ability
authors: Lijun Wang, Kaibo Gao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Educational expectations play an important role in adolescents’ cognitive development and human capital accumulation. Using four waves of the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) from 2010, 2014, 2018, and 2022, this article examines how parental educational expectations, children’s own educational expectations, and parent–child educational expectation discrepancies relate to adolescents’ cognitive ability. We find that both parental and children’s own educational expectations are positively associated with cognitive ability. However, relative to aligned expectations, discrepancies in either direction, whether parental educational expectations exceed or fall below children’s expectations, are associated with significantly lower cognitive ability among adolescents. Mechanism analyses suggest that discrepancies in either direction are associated with more frequent parent–child conflict. Upward-biased discrepancies are associated with lower adolescent academic self-efficacy, whereas downward-biased discrepancies are associated with lower parental homework involvement. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that these negative associations are stronger among students in regular class tracks, students from low-income households, students with less-educated parents, and rural students. Further analysis suggests that consistently high and aligned expectations correspond to the highest cognitive ability. These findings highlight the potential importance of expectation alignment within families and suggest that disadvantaged rural and low-income groups may warrant particular attention in educational policy design.
abstract_zh: 教育期望在青少年认知发展与人力资本积累中扮演重要角色。本文基于2010年、2014年、2018年和2022年四期中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，考察父母教育期望、子女自身教育期望及亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关系。研究发现：父母教育期望与子女自身教育期望均与认知能力呈正相关。然而，相较于期望一致的情形，无论父母期望高于还是低于子女期望，期望偏差均与青少年认知能力显著降低相关。机制分析表明，双向期望偏差均与更频繁的亲子冲突相关；向上偏差与青少年学业自我效能感降低相关，而向下偏差则与父母作业辅导参与度降低相关。异质性分析显示，上述负向关联在普通班学生、低收入家庭学生、父母受教育程度较低的学生及农村学生中更为显著。进一步分析表明，持续且一致的较高期望对应最高水平的认知能力。这些发现凸显了家庭内部期望一致性的潜在重要性，并提示教育政策设计应特别关注处于弱势地位的农村与低收入群体。

title: Initial Margin for Crypto Currencies Risks in Uncleared Markets
title_zh: 未清算市场中加密货币风险的初始保证金
title_primary: 未清算市场中加密货币风险的初始保证金
title_secondary: Initial Margin for Crypto Currencies Risks in Uncleared Markets
authors: Anna Amirdjanova, David Lynch, Anni Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine prospective classification of crypto currencies risks within the ISDA Standardized Initial Margin Model (SIMM) framework for calculation of initial margin on trades sensitive to cryptocurrencies’ risk factors in the uncleared market. Consistent with the view that cryptocurrencies are digital assets that fundamentally rely on distributed ledger technology (DLT) and induce financial risks that are significantly different from those in traditional risk classes like commodities or FX, we find that cryptocurrencies are best classified into a distinct risk class within SIMM that is split into two buckets – pegged and floating (unpegged) crypto currencies as risk factors - and suggest risk weights’ calibration methodology within the cryptocurrencies risk class that is consistent with the existing approaches adopted in SIMM.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在ISDA标准化初始保证金模型（SIMM）框架下，对未清算市场中受加密货币风险因子影响的交易进行初始保证金计算时，加密货币风险的预期分类问题。基于加密货币本质上是依赖分布式账本技术（DLT）的数字资产，且其引发的金融风险与商品或外汇等传统风险类别存在显著差异这一观点，我们发现加密货币在SIMM中最适合归入一个独立的风险类别，该类别进一步划分为两个子类——锚定型与浮动型（非锚定型）加密货币作为风险因子——并提出了加密货币风险类别内的风险权重校准方法，该方法与SIMM现有方法保持一致。

title: Heterogeneous firms and the investment transmission mechanism of monetary policy
title_zh: 异质性企业与货币政策的投资传导机制
title_primary: 异质性企业与货币政策的投资传导机制
title_secondary: Heterogeneous firms and the investment transmission mechanism of monetary policy
authors: Hanwen Zhang, Xiaoke Sun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article investigates how firm-level financial positions shape corporate investment responses to policy-related monetary shocks in China. Guided by a heterogeneous firm framework in which net worth governs financing constraints, we link an event-based monetary shock measure to panel data on Chinese listed firms. We document three main findings. First, monetary transmission varies systematically with within-firm leverage states: following expansionary shocks, firms with leverage above their own historical average experience larger reductions in effective financing costs and stronger increases in investment. This pattern is consistent with an important role for the balance-sheet channel in a bank-dominated financial system. Second, this heterogeneity is asymmetric: it is pronounced during monetary easing but statistically insignificant during tightening episodes. Third, ownership structure matters. The leverage-driven amplification is substantial among non-state-owned firms but muted among state-owned enterprises. Overall, our findings show that balance-sheet conditions and institutional frictions jointly shape the investment transmission of monetary policy in China, with implications for the design of stabilization policy and structural reform.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业层面的财务状况如何塑造中国企业对政策性货币冲击的投资反应。在净财富决定融资约束的异质性企业框架指导下，我们将基于事件的货币冲击度量与我国上市公司面板数据相结合。我们记录了三个主要发现。首先，货币传导随企业内杠杆状态的系统性变化：在扩张性冲击之后，杠杆高于自身历史平均水平的企业，其有效融资成本降幅更大，投资增长更为强劲。这一模式与银行主导金融体系中资产负债表渠道的重要作用相一致。其次，这种异质性具有不对称性：在货币宽松时期显著，而在紧缩阶段统计上不显著。第三，所有权结构具有影响。杠杆驱动的放大效应在非国有企业中显著，而在国有企业中则较为微弱。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，资产负债表状况和制度性摩擦共同塑造了中国货币政策对投资传导的影响，这对稳定政策的设计和结构性改革具有启示意义。

title: The Hard Problem and the Tyranny of the Losers
title_zh: 硬问题与失败者的暴政
title_primary: 硬问题与失败者的暴政
title_secondary: The Hard Problem and the Tyranny of the Losers
authors: Stan Cheung, Marco Mariotti, Roberto Veneziani
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A Hard Problem is a collective choice problem in which the only feasible alternatives to the status quo consist of a welfare gain to some people (the Winners) and a welfare loss to others (the Losers). These problems are typical in a number of settings, such as climate action, anti-trust regulation, and tax design. We study how to make collective choices when faced with Hard Problems. We find that a relatively weak fairness requirement, which we call Expansion Solidarity, necessarily leads to a dictatorship of the Losers, no matter how small their number. Even one single Loser must be given the power to veto any departure from the status quo, regardless of the number of Winners, how large the gains, how small the loss, or how extreme the welfare inequalities.
abstract_zh: 硬问题”是一种集体选择问题，其中唯一可行的替代现状方案包括对某些人（赢家）的福利增益和对其他人（输家）的福利损失。这类问题在多种情境中普遍存在，如气候行动、反垄断监管和税收设计。我们研究在面对硬问题时如何做出集体选择。我们发现，一个相对较弱的公平性要求，我们称之为“扩展团结”，必然导致输家的独裁，无论其数量多么微小。即便只有一个输家，也必须被赋予否决任何偏离现状的权力，不论赢家数量多少、增益多大、损失多小，或福利不平等程度多么极端。

title: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
title_zh: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果
title_primary: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果
title_secondary: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
authors: Alexander W. Bartik, Evan Mast
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Since 1970, the share of Black individuals living in suburbs of large cities has risen from 16% to 36%. We first show that Black suburbanization has led to major changes in neighborhoods, accounting for the majority of recent increases in both the average Black individual’s neighborhood quality and income segregation within the Black population. We then use an accounting exercise to show that changes in relative suburban amenities and housing prices explain a large share of Black suburbanization, while regional reallocation, changing educational attainment, and gentrification of Black city neighborhoods play only minor roles.
abstract_zh: 自1970年以来，居住在大城市郊区的黑人比例已从16%上升至36%。我们首先表明，黑人郊区化导致了社区的重大变化，这解释了近年来黑人个体平均社区质量提升以及黑人群体内部收入隔离加剧的大部分原因。随后，我们通过核算分析表明，郊区相对便利设施和房价的变化解释了黑人郊区化的很大一部分原因，而区域重新分配、教育程度变化以及黑人城市社区的绅士化仅起到次要作用。

title: Agenda manipulation under doctrinal paradox
title_zh: 教义悖论下的议程操纵
title_primary: 教义悖论下的议程操纵
title_secondary: Agenda manipulation under doctrinal paradox
authors: Masaki Miyashita
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the aggregation of individuals’ beliefs into their collective judgment on a certain proposition, called the conclusion , which is logically related to other preliminary propositions. While the literature has highlighted the crucial dependency of voting outcomes on the selection of an agenda —i.e., the set of propositions voted on—the structure of this dependency is not well understood. We introduce two novel premise-based rules, defined through the conjunctive normal form and disjunctive normal form of the conclusion. Our theorem shows that for any profile of voters’ beliefs, these rules respectively yield the highest and lowest voting outcomes, with respect to a given total order over the set of truth values, within the class of all premise-based rules. This result clarifies the extent to which a voting outcome can be manipulated through the selection of an agenda. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 本文研究个体信念如何聚合为对某一命题（称为“结论”）的集体判断，该结论与其他前提性命题存在逻辑关联。现有文献虽已强调投票结果对议程（即被投票的命题集合）选择的关键依赖性，但这一依赖关系的结构尚未得到充分理解。我们引入两种基于前提的新规则，分别通过结论的合取范式与析取范式进行定义。定理表明：对于任意选民信念分布，在给定真值集合的全序关系下，这两类规则分别在所有基于前提的规则中产生最高与最低的投票结果。该结论揭示了通过议程选择操纵投票结果的可能边界。

title: Nonlinearities With Deanchored Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 去锚定通胀预期的非线性特征
title_primary: 去锚定通胀预期的非线性特征
title_secondary: Nonlinearities With Deanchored Inflation Expectations
authors: Stefano Fasani, Mirela Miescu, Lorenza Rossi
official: 官方在线 2026-03-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a nonlinear VAR, we examine the asymmetric effects of shocks to long-run inflation expectations. Negative shocks, which temporarily lower long-run inflation expectations, have a stronger and more persistent impact on output, investment, and firm entry compared to positive shocks. We provide a novel theoretical explanation, demonstrating how these shocks influence the second-order components of the model, shaping firms' “wait-and-see” behavior—particularly along both the intensive and extensive margins of the investment channel.
abstract_zh: 利用非线性VAR模型，我们考察了长期通胀预期冲击的非对称效应。相较于正向冲击，负向冲击虽暂时降低长期通胀预期，但对产出、投资及企业进入的影响更为强劲且持久。我们提出了一种新颖的理论解释，展示了这些冲击如何作用于模型的二阶成分，塑造企业的“观望”行为——尤其是在投资渠道的集约边际与扩展边际上。

title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
title_zh: 早期儿童发展政策的宏观经济后果
title_primary: 早期儿童发展政策的宏观经济后果
title_secondary: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
authors: Diego Daruich
official: 官方在线 2026-01-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.
abstract_zh: 为研究长期大规模早期儿童政策，本文将早期儿童投资纳入一个以美国数据校准的通用均衡异质性主体世代交叠模型中。模型中对短期小规模早期儿童项目的随机对照试验评估预测，对儿童教育及收入的影响与实证证据相似。然而，即便考虑了一般均衡与税收效应，长期大规模项目带来的福利收益是短期小规模项目的两倍以上。这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升了其个人技能，还为未来世代创造了更优秀的祖先。

title: Understanding productivity gaps: the nexus between intangible capital and market power

authors: Cecilia Jona-Lasinio, Stefano Manzocchi, Enrico Marvasi

abstract: Over the past decade, the United States has experienced a significant productivity advantage over the European Union, leading to a widening productivity gap. This divergence is characterized by a rapid shift towards intangible investment and rising markups in the US economy relative to the EU. Also, existing studies have predominantly focused on the US, often neglecting the role of intangible capital in shaping both productivity and markup dynamics, as well as their measurement. This paper addresses this gap by integrating intangibles and markups into a macroeconomic productivity framework, examining their interaction and their contribution to the EU-US productivity divide. Using EUKLEMS&INTANProd panel data, we estimate the impact of intangible investments on productivity in a framework considering also their links with markups. Our results show that: 1) properly accounting for intangibles implies lower estimated markups, particularly in the US and in high intangible-intensive sectors; 2) the US’ robust productivity growth can be partially attributed to earlier and more significant investments in intangible assets, which also helps explain the observed dynamics in markups; 3) in contrast, the EU lags in intangible capital and shows less significant markup trends.
